notes: Extended MetroCluster coverage from Technical Audit (5.6.23) to the Action Planner and deliverables, as requested. (1) The Action Planner's MetroCluster Infrastructure Health widget was gated on mcRisks.length > 0 -- the same gap just fixed in Technical Audit -- so a fleet with real MC systems but zero findings showed nothing. Now gates on the real isMetroCluster field and always shows MC node count, Mediator status, and AUSO status, including a clean all-clear state. (2) computeFleetDRSummary() now also returns mcMediatorIssues/mcAusoDisabled, and the QBR Pack and Security Brief's existing DR Posture sections now include a 'MetroCluster Health: Mediator [status] | AUSO [status]' line whenever MC systems are in scope. Verified live against 8 real MetroCluster systems: Action Planner now shows 'MetroCluster system(s) in scope — no MetroCluster-specific findings detected', QBR Pack includes 'MetroCluster Health: Mediator OK | AUSO ENABLED'.
